description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Visual preferences icons:** about 290 more settings now have an icon, and about 60 of their sub options get a blank icon so the text lines up. This covers Feed, Player (including fullscreen, seekbar, haptic feedback and swipe controls), Comments, Video description, Ads, General, Navigation bar, Toolbar, the built-in downloader options, Return YouTube Dislike, Return YouTube Username, Gemini, Voice Over Translation, Spoof video streams and Proxy.
- **Visual preferences icons:** the SponsorBlock settings (appearance, segment categories, create segment and general rows) now have icons too.
- The icons follow the patch's `Icon style` option: Regular (default) or Bold.

## Bug Fixes
- **YouTube - Miniplayer:** on 21.30 and newer, the feed no longer goes blank when the player is minimized with animations on (`Force animations`). Ported from Morphe.
- **YouTube - Miniplayer:** on 21.30 and newer, the maximize animation of the miniplayer stays on while horizontal drag is enabled. Ported from Morphe.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.16.1...v1.17.0)
